title: Racial Bias, Explainability, and EU AI Act Compliance: analysis code
description: Reproduction code for the article 'Racial Bias, Explainability, and EU AI Act Compliance: A SHAP-Based Empirical Analysis of Recidivism Prediction on the COMPAS Dataset'. Eleven numbered Python scripts reproduce every table and figure of the manuscript from the public ProPublica COMPAS file.
